title: A path helper gets a per-OS separator, and the guide keeps the old call

pr.title: Join paths with the separator of the target OS
pr.description: joinPath() gets an os parameter. Windows paths now use a backslash. The default stays posix, so the callers keep working.

bugs.note: docs/guide.md still shows the old call joinPath(dir, name) and says that the separator is always a forward slash. The change adds the os parameter and a backslash for windows, so a reader of the guide gets wrong Windows paths. The guide must show the os parameter and the per-OS separator.

traps.why: "\\" in TypeScript source is one backslash, the Windows separator. A finding that the separator has two backslashes is wrong.
